hypothesis: A codec-only capture stream isolates ATen cuBLAS/cuBLASLt workspace ranges from model graphs; this is not an established cause of prior async quality failures.
isolated_variable: default versus dedicated codec capture stream; within each, sync versus poll/thread replay with same initial state, corpus, RNG and admission trace.

gate: Exact per-step output codes/roster and metadata, all final mutable tensors, PCM bytes and completion order. Dedicated capture must expose nonempty disjoint ATen workspace address ranges.
stop: Any mismatch stops this arm, preserving raw evidence; no repetition or performance claim.
limitations: Extra full-code and metadata D2H per decode step can alter overlap timing relative to service.
ATen workspace map inspection does not cover other libraries scratch or prove executed kernel uses each cached workspace.
Single feasibility replay is not 1088-request WER/SIM validation or all-concurrency promotion.
